description: Source code for thread management and context initialization in Zephyr OS for Xtensa architecture.

methods.name: init_stack
methods.description: Initializes a thread stack with the specified entry point and arguments.

methods.name: arch_new_thread
methods.description: Creates a new thread with a given stack, entry point, and parameters.

methods.name: arch_float_disable
methods.description: Disables FPU for a thread (not supported on Xtensa).

methods.name: arch_float_enable
methods.description: Enables FPU for a thread (always enabled on Xtensa).

methods.name: arch_user_mode_enter
methods.description: Transitions to user mode and starts execution of user thread.
